Angsana Golf Residences Topaz

Condominium in Laguna Phuket (near Bang Tao)
HomeNew ProjectsAngsana Golf Residences Topaz

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Angsana Golf Residences Topaz is a branded residential development by Banyan Group Residences inside the Laguna Phuket integrated resort. It consists of three curved low-rise buildings, each divided into two interconnected blocks, with two- and three-bedroom residences and penthouses. The ring-shaped rooftop pool offers views over the golf course, mountains and coast. Owners receive Laguna Golf Phuket membership and RAVA Beach Club access.

Facilities & amenities

  • Ring-shaped rooftop pool with 360-degree views
  • Ground-floor BBQ area in tropical gardens
  • Penthouses with private rooftop pools
  • Direct garden access for ground-floor units
  • Community: Laguna Golf Phuket membership
  • Community: RAVA Beach Club Prestige Zone access
  • Community: Sanctuary Club
  • Community: Laguna Wellness by BDMS

Frequently asked questions

Where is Angsana Golf Residences Topaz?

Angsana Golf Residences Topaz is a low-rise branded residences project in Laguna Phuket (near Bang Tao), Phuket, developed by Banyan Group Residences (Banyan Group). Address: Laguna Phuket, Choeng Thale, Thalang, Phuket.

What is the starting price of Angsana Golf Residences Topaz?

Agent advertised price is ฿22,840,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Angsana Golf Residences Topaz?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Angsana Golf Residences Topaz be ready?

Current status: under construction; completion date listed as Q4 2027 (advertised, not confirmed by developer). Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
